description: Import caption files (.srt, .scc, .mcc, .dfxp, .stl, .xml: SubRip, Scenarist, MacCaption, DFXP, EBU STL, W3C/SMPTE/EBU Timed Text XML) into the project without Premiere Pro's dialogs (File > Import), into the root or a bin. Each becomes a captions item to place on a caption track

bin.description: Import into this bin. Default: the project root

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

name: import_captions
title: Import Captions
